name: The Open University · OpenLearn
access: OpenLearn offers free study. Course pages describe which activities, quizzes and progress features require an account. Hours and levels come from the catalogue.

name: Open Yale Courses
access: Yale publishes lecture series with transcripts and audio. Readings and assignments vary by course. Some assigned editions require a library or purchase.

name: HarvardX on edX
access: Check the course’s current audit option, duration and assessment access. edX lists both free and paid tracks. Harvard also publishes some materials directly.

name: Yale on Coursera
access: Yale identifies these as revised courses moved to Coursera. The current free portion, signup terms and assessment access need checking on each destination.

name: MIT OpenCourseWare
access: MIT publishes course materials without registration. Each course lists the readings, assignments and media available.

name: Coursera
access: Check the individual course for previews, enrollment and prices.

name: edX
access: Check the individual course for its free audit period and graded work.

name: FutureLearn
access: Check the individual offering for its access period and subscription requirements.

name: The Open University on FutureLearn
access: The OU also teaches on FutureLearn. The course page gives its enrollment and access conditions.

name: NPTEL · India
access: This is a dated offering. Its preview describes the course. The permanent NPTEL page, where listed, is another place to look for study materials after enrollment closes.

name: SWAYAM · India
access: Look on the individual offering for enrollment dates and assessment requirements.

name: France Université Numérique
access: The course page gives its language, session dates and participation terms.

name: Class Central
access: Search across providers and bring a course link into your private plan. Providers establish access terms.
